task: Review simulator warmup cleanup/status preservation and timeout behavior; diagnostic failures must never become actual test passes.

inspectedRevision.unchangedSource: git diff 4d0c67d258be802f048e74616cabcdf903e2b59d -- scripts/boot_simulator.py scripts/tests/test_boot_simulator.py .github/workflows/ios-prototype.yml produced no output. HEAD advances only documentation/evidence relative to source. Unrelated existing worktree edits were observed and left untouched.

tests.result: Commands run in owned process sessions; timeout, nonzero exit, normal exit and interruption paths attempt owned-group SIGKILL and direct-child reap. Return codes remain the child wait result; timeout and interruption status are retained. Cleanup failures terminate verification. Raw stdout/stderr, per-command receipts and incremental report remain separate; output directory must be new.

tests.check: Shared deadline and bounded recovery policy
tests.result: Default 580-second budget reserves five seconds for cleanup within the ten-minute CI step. Both attempts, inventory and target-only shutdown use the shared work deadline. Recovery is at most once and requires github-hosted CI. Device UDID/runtime/type/availability and post-boot state are revalidated. Cancellation, tool-signal, malformed-identity, and cleanup failures are terminal.

Inspected synthetic coverage for partial logs and original nonzero statuses, two timeouts sharing budget, postflight timeouts and identity errors, cleanup failures, owned descendants on success/failure/timeout, cancellation and finalization interruption, invalid budgets, existing evidence, and late exit zero. These tests were read, not executed.

tests.check: ios-prototype.yml native and UI warmup/test/accounting/artifact steps
tests.result: Only warmup is continue-on-error; steps.simulator_warmup.outcome is logged explicitly as diagnostic. Actual xcodebuild uses set -euo pipefail, exact selected UDID and independently selected required methods. Required native/UI accounting runs with always(); native Metal methods require one pass each; finalized xcresult is required. Warmup reports/raw logs upload with always(). No source path converts preparatory readiness into a test pass.

tests.check: Python regression suites, simulator startup, native/XCTest runs
tests.result: No tests or runtime probes executed, as directed. No Apple runtime behavior or current CI pass inferred from source.

outcome: No confirmed material defect in assigned warmup implementation or CI separation. Source-only review. Parent-reported genuine room-test failure after five methods executed remains a distinct required-test failure; it is not recategorized as a historical runner/warmup failure and was not independently investigated in this assignment.
